description.value:
Cost 2 Vitae

Duration 1 minute

The jaw comes forward first. It always comes forward first.

You grow a jaw that does not fit your face. You gain a jaws unarmed attack dealing 2d8 piercing damage with the grapple and deadly d8 traits. While the form lasts you cannot speak above a growl, and you take a −2 circumstance penalty to Diplomacy checks.

cinderfall.incomplete: Grants a jaws unarmed Strike for the duration -- needs a Strike rule element on a companion effect, same as Morning Claws. This is an activated, duration-limited self-buff shaped exactly like this corpus's own 13 companion-effect pairs (apex-draught -> apex-draught-effect, etc.) and the real pf2e precedent for that shape (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json + equipment-effects/effect-juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json; feats/class/monk/level-1/gorilla-stance.json + feat-effects/stance-gorilla-stance.json) -- in both, the triggering card's rules: [] is correct and the numeric payload lives on a separate companion Effect item the triggering card GrantItems into. No matching *-effect.json companion exists for this card, so the mechanism is real but the sibling file it would need is missing -- a card-authoring gap, not an engine limitation.
